products.title: Mushroom Broth Mixed Pack (6 Pack with Free Shipping)
products.body_html:
Try all three flavors of our mushroom broth: Lions Mane, Chaga, and Maitake in our mushroom broth mixed pack. 

Each broth is packed full of organic mushrooms, simple, and clean ingredients, perfect for sipping, soup, or stock. Our mixed pack includes two boxes of each broth flavor. 

Free shipping or pick up at the barn!

products.title: Maitake Mushroom Broth (4 Pack with Free Shipping)
products.body_html:
Two River Mushroom Broth is made with organic Maitake Mushrooms, coconut milk, and 20 other simple ingredients. Celebrated for centuries for its nourishing and functional qualities, Maitake is known for supporting overall wellness, helping the body adapt to stress, and contributing to immune balance, thanks to its naturally occurring beta-glucans and powerful antioxidants.

It's comforting, grounding, and satisfying, delicious as a sipping drink, it can also be substituted for stock and pairs well with a variety of recipes, from curries to soups and beyond.

Free shipping or local pickup at The Farm!

products.title: Chaga Mushroom Broth (4 pack with Free Shipping)
products.body_html:
Two River Mushroom Broth is made with organic wild-harvested Chaga Mushrooms, alongside 20 other simple ingredients to create a broth that is savory and earthy with a rich, umami flavor, and boasting anti-inflammatory properties.

It's comforting and satisfying, delicious as a sipping drink, it can also be substituted for stock and pairs well with a variety of recipes, from simple miso soups and Ramen, to the base for vegetarian gravy.

Free shipping or local pickup at The Farm! *Unlike other mushrooms, Chaga does not fully dissolve. Our organic broth may contain some larger pieces and inconsistencies, it's all normal.*

products.title: Lion’s Mane & Shiitake Mushroom Broth (4 Pack with Free Shipping)
products.body_html:
Two River Mushroom Broth is made with organic Lion's Mane and Shiitake Mushrooms, alongside 20 other simple ingredients to create a broth that is savory and earthy with a rich, umami flavor. It's comforting and satisfying, delicious as a sipping drink, it can also be substituted for stock and pairs well with a variety of recipes, from simple miso soups and Ramen, to the base for vegetarian gravy.

  • Rich Umami Flavor – A satisfying base for soups, risottos, ramen, or sipping straight from the mug.
  • Functional Ingredients – Includes adaptogenic mushrooms known to support immune health, focus, and energy.
  • Clean & Organic – Made with certified organic produce and mushrooms, with no preservatives or artificial anything.
  • Plant-Based & Gluten-Free – 100% vegan, gluten-free, and dairy-free — perfect for most dietary lifestyles.
  • Ready to Use – Conveniently packaged in 4 individual containers; heat, pour, and enjoy.
